'''Malrik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One day, during a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] orchestrated by [[Bulsar]], his [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] partner, and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Netek]], he quickly grew wary. Accusing Bulsar of cheating, Malrik ordered a search and later grew frustrated over stolen cargo, believing Bulsar had taken it. When tensions boiled over, Malrik confronted Netek, pointing his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] at the Quarren. However, Netek reacted swiftly, killing Malrik in the ensuing conflict.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malrik was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
